# Frozen ROUTE-LEVEL vectors: contract components -> the COMPLETE resolved route.
#
# Each row binds the whole ResolvedRoute tuple, not just the subject. Asserting the subject
# alone let two production mutants pass: shifting route.partition by one while keeping the
# subject suffix, and renaming both physical streams without incrementing placement_version.
#
# RECOVERY rows are included. Its singular subject and nil partition were covered only by
# behavioural tests, so its VERSIONED TUPLE was unbound -- a placement or version change on the
# recovery lane would have slipped past the corpus that exists to catch exactly that. Recovery's
# partition column is the literal `nil`, never `0`: zero is a real partition.
#
# Format:
#   <route_profile>\t<traffic_class>\t<scope hex>\t<agent id>\t<spool hex>\t<subject>\t<partition|nil>\t<stream>\t<placement_v>\t<partition_scheme_v>
